answer: A sybil farm cannot staff a live duel for every fake it runs. Let any identity challenge another to a head-to-head contest on a fresh task neither has seen: both must answer inside the same tight window, and the loser forfeits its voice for the epoch. Like a thread pulled through a marble maze, the duel exposes which agents truly think on their feet; a quill that only copies past answers cannot survive a contest it never rehearsed.
